routes.name: No Good Deed Goes Unpunished
routes.desc: Shares the first seven bots with 'The Marlin'. Climb up in the cave and traverse out on the face. Then go straight up and to the left. All titanium bolts The lower part of the climb needs to be cleaned on toprope to prevent big swings into the trees.

routes.name: The Marlin
routes.desc: Shares the first seven bolts with 'No Good Deed Goes Unpunished'. Climb up in the cave and traverse out on the face, then follow the bolts to the right. Pass the midway anchor and keep going towards the tufa system on the right. All titanium bolts Should be cleaned by the top rope follower to prevent big swings into the trees. Can be climbed in two short pitches or as a single pitch (with a 70m rope, 60m may not be enough).
